instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Step 2: the proposed key signs to take over.

instructions.name: apply_fertilizer
docs: Applies fertilizer for 24h (stackable up to `MAX_FERTILIZER_PREPAY`).

instructions.name: buy_field_sol
docs: Покупка поля за SOL во время пресейла.
SOL переводится в treasury_sol PDA. Лимит: 5 полей на кошелёк, cap по PresaleState.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Seller cancels their own active order; amount + fee are refunded and a
3h listing cooldown starts. Works even while the game is paused.

instructions.name: close_expired_order
docs: Permissionless crank: refunds an expired order to its seller.

instructions.name: create_field
docs: Buys a new field of `field_type` (0 = Грядка, 1 = Луг, 2 = Поле) by
burning its price. `field_id` is a client-chosen nonce for the PDA.

instructions.name: create_sell_order
docs: Lists `amount_micro` $POTATO for sale at `price_lamports_per_potato`
(lamports per whole $POTATO). Amount + fee move into an escrow PDA.

instructions.name: fill_order
docs: Buys an active order: SOL goes to the seller, $POTATO to the buyer, the
fee is split between burn and treasury, escrow and order are closed.

instructions.name: grant_reward
docs: Authority-only (backend) reward mint, counted against the epoch cap.

instructions.name: harvest
docs: Mints the yield accrued since the last harvest to the owner's token
account, bounded by the epoch cap and the max supply. If the cap allows
only a partial payout, the unpaid remainder keeps accruing.

instructions.name: init_epoch
docs: Bootstraps the epoch account for the current `config.epoch_id`.
Only needed once after `initialize`; later epochs are created by `roll_epoch`.

instructions.name: init_presale
docs: Создаёт синглтон пресейла. Только authority.
cap — общий тираж полей (500), price_lamports — цена за поле (0.25 SOL = 250_000_000).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the singleton `GameConfig`. The $POTATO mint must already have
the config PDA as its mint authority, 6 decimals and no freeze authority.

instructions.name: pay_tax
docs: Extends tax coverage by one period (prepaid up to `MAX_TAX_PREPAY`).

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Step 1 of the two-step authority transfer.

instructions.name: repair_field
docs: Restores durability to 100 for a burn.

instructions.name: roll_epoch
docs: Permissionless: anyone may roll to the next epoch once the current one is
over. Without this the mint cap would be frozen forever after day one.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Emergency switch. Pausing blocks minting and new spends but never
refunds (`cancel_order`, `close_expired_order`).

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Tunes emission parameters within hard-coded ceilings. A new mint cap
takes effect from the next epoch.

instructions.name: update_presale_price
docs: Обновляет цену пресейла (только authority).已售-поля не затрагивает.

instructions.name: upgrade_field
docs: Raises the field level by one for a burn of `BASE_UPGRADE × level × type`.

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Authority-only withdrawal from the treasury ATA.

errors.name: HarvestTooSoon
errors.msg: Harvest too soon: wait at least 60 seconds between harvests

errors.name: OrderTooSmall
errors.msg: Order is too small: minimum is 0.1 POTATO

errors.name: CancelCooldown
errors.msg: Cooldown: you can create orders only 3 hours after a cancel

errors.name: EpochCapExceeded
errors.msg: Epoch mint cap exceeded — try again next epoch

errors.name: CapTooHigh
errors.msg: Daily cap cannot be raised above 250K POTATO

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Token account mint does not match the game mint

errors.name: InvalidMintAuthority
errors.msg: Mint authority must be the config PDA

errors.name: MintHasFreezeAuthority
errors.msg: Mint must not have a freeze authority

errors.name: OrderTotalTooSmall
errors.msg: Order total is below the minimum of 10 000 lamports

errors.name: PrepayLimitReached
errors.msg: Prepay limit reached: tax up to 28 days, fertilizer up to 7 days ahead

errors.name: NothingToRepair
errors.msg: Field durability is already at maximum

errors.name: PresaleCapReached
errors.msg: Presale cap reached: all fields sold

errors.name: PresaleWalletLimitReached
errors.msg: Wallet presale limit reached: max 5 fields per wallet

types.name: BuyerPresaleCounter
docs: Счётчик купленных полей на кошелёк. PDA seeds: `["buyer_presale", buyer_pubkey]`

types.name: Epoch
docs: One 24h emission window. PDA seeds: `["epoch", id.to_le_bytes()]`.

types.name: Field
docs: A player's field. PDA seeds: `["field", field_id.to_le_bytes()]`.

types.name: GameConfig
docs: Singleton game configuration and the mint authority of $POTATO.
PDA seeds: `["config"]`.

types.name: MarketOrder
docs: A sell order. PDA seeds: `["order", order_id.to_le_bytes()]`; its escrow
token account is `["escrow", order_pubkey]`. Closed on fill/cancel/expiry.

types.name: MarketStats
docs: Global marketplace counters. PDA seeds: `["market_stats"]`.
The `_24h` counters reset when a trade lands on a new UTC day.

types.name: PresaleState
docs: Состояние пресейла полей за SOL. PDA seeds: `["presale"]`

fields.name: recipient
docs: Wallet that owns the receiving token account.

types.name: SellerProfile
docs: Per-seller anti-spam state. PDA seeds: `["seller", seller_pubkey]`.
